runtime_browser_suite.command: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/workspace" -w /workspace immersive-browser-test python3 -m pytest -q tests

host_capture_conversion_suite.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_phone_capture.py tests/test_live_scan.py tests/test_pose_registration.py tests/test_video_projection.py tests/test_library_conversion.py tests/test_h264_timing.py tests/test_seam_candidate.py

media.rendering: Full visual picture tracks, silent, common 521875/17451 cadence, native per-node files
media.mapping: Experimental scan-derived geometry baked into clips; saved room model unchanged

acceleration.gpu: Apple M3 / OpenCL mapping and VideoToolbox video encode
acceleration.benchmark_limitation: Short 180-frame benchmark; full-length throughput depends on codec and source projection
acceleration.missing_sps_timing_fix: Remux with added VUI timing; compressed picture bytes and decoded pixels preserved

capture.recovery: Four pose segments registered through common QR anchors

open_work: Diagnose intermittent frame deadlines and presentation-skew failures on longer runs. Reported software skew is not optical genlock.
Validate global seams, nonplanar surfaces and radiometric blending; held-out scan residuals exceed the production target.
Implement reliable automatic live scan completion and acquisition guidance.
Rebuild Yocto image with the current runtime and perform a physical boot test. Existing local image predates the deployed runtime.
excluded_artifacts: Raw phone recordings, generated media, build archives and signing material remain local.
